questions.question: Which country features the highest capital city in the world by elevation, La Paz?
questions.fun_fact: La Paz sits at an impressive altitude of approximately 3,650 meters (11,975 feet) above sea level.

questions.question: What is the primary gas found in the atmosphere of Venus?
questions.fun_fact: Carbon dioxide makes up about 96.5% of Venus's thick atmosphere, driving a runaway greenhouse effect.

questions.question: The historic Battle of Waterloo, which marked the final defeat of Napoleon Bonaparte, took place in the year of what?
questions.fun_fact: The decisive battle was fought on June 18, 1815, near Waterloo in present-day Belgium.

questions.question: Which actor provided the iconic voice of Darth Vader in the original Star Wars trilogy?
questions.fun_fact: While David Prowse physically portrayed the villain in the suit, James Earl Jones provided the booming, unforgettable voice.

questions.question: In traditional Italian cooking, what is the primary cheese used to make authentic Genovese pesto?
questions.fun_fact: Authentic pesto genovese combines fresh basil, garlic, pine nuts, coarse salt, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Pecorino, and olive oil.

questions.question: What unique physical adaptation allows owls to see their surroundings despite their eyes being fixed in their sockets?
options: They can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees
They possess a second set of transparent eyelids
They can echolocate using specialized ear tufts
questions.fun_fact: Owls have 14 neck vertebrae, allowing them to swivel their heads remarkably far to compensate for immovable eyes.

questions.question: How many total players are on the ice for a single ice hockey team during a standard regulation game (excluding the goaltender)?
questions.fun_fact: A standard team fields five skaters (three forwards and two defenders) plus one goaltender.

questions.question: What linguistic term is used to describe a word formed from the initial letters of other words, such as 'NASA' or 'Scuba', that is pronounced as a single word?
questions.fun_fact: Unlike initialisms where each letter is pronounced individually (like FBI), acronyms are pronounced as whole words.

questions.question: Which moon of Saturn is famous for possessing a thick nitrogen-rich atmosphere and liquid methane lakes on its surface?
questions.fun_fact: Titan is the only moon in our solar system known to have a dense atmosphere and stable bodies of surface liquid.

questions.question: The Gulf of Bothnia separates which two European countries?
questions.fun_fact: The Gulf of Bothnia is the northernmost arm of the Baltic Sea, situated between Sweden to the west and Finland to the east.
